messages:
Sam (AE): FYI POC update from Marina: they want invoices to be issued to Entity-A but actual wires to come from Entity-B. Also asking for a 5% holdback for 90 days tied to POC acceptance. Need legal + finance on routing and signature flow.

Marina (Customer): Correct. Our treasury insists on paying from Entity-B for cash management reasons. We can provide a brief intercompany memo.

Priya (Sales Ops): DocuSign question 1 do they want both entities to sign separate OFs or sign one OF with both signers? We can do parallel lanes or embedded signing.

Sam (AE): They prefer separate OFs per entity but simultaneous completion. I'll confirm exact signer names/emails.

Jordan (Legal): We can accept multi-entity payment: recommend single MSA + two OFs. Redline to OF: billing/payor clause + requirement for intercompany agreement or treasury memo + authorized signer representation. For holdback, tie release to objective acceptance criteria; add cap language.

Kenji (Finance): Finance can accept wires from a different payor if we receive: W-9/W-8 per entity, beneficiary bank form, and intercompany memo. Note: we'll assign GL code HB-POC for the 5% holdback liability and it will delay revenue recognition until release. Ops will block activation until docs verified.

Marina (Customer): Uploading W-9 (A), W-8BEN-E (B), bank beneficiary pdf, and a 1-page intercompany memo now.

Priya (Sales Ops): I'll set up DocuSign with parallel lanes (OF-A and OF-B). Adding an internal "holdback" checkbox that pauses activation and pings Finance. Sam, please add files to the envelope.

Sam (AE): Done. Envelope ready but not sent. Jordan, can you paste a short redline snippet to include in the OF so Treasury can approve?

Jordan (Legal): Paste this: `Where Customer includes multiple legal entities, the Order Form shall designate a Billing Entity to receive invoices and may designate a separate Payor Entity authorized to remit payment. Redwood will accept payment from the Payor Entity provided Customer delivers evidence of the PayorBilling relationship (intercompany agreement or treasury memo) and required tax and bank documentation. Any holdback shall not exceed 5% of the Order Form value and will be released upon Redwood's written acceptance of the POC deliverables or upon mutual written agreement. Redwood may limit aggregate holdback exposure to the total value of services performed during the POC.`

LedgerBot: Note: Attachments uploaded. Reminder: add doc IDs for W-9/W-8 and bank form in the envelope.

Kenji (Finance): Once docs verified we'll clear activation. Expect 1 business day for review. If they insist on earlier activation, we need a signed escrow or proof of funds.

Sam (AE): OK plan: include Jordan text, send parallel DocuSign once docs attached, hold completion until Kenji confirms. Marina thanks for fast uploads. :thumbsup:

Priya (Sales Ops): SFDC tags: needs-legal, needs-finance, docsign-parallel. Creating internal ticket to track HB-POC GL code and activation hold.
